                                                                                                                                 <div class="item">
                                        <h3>An Unmatched Experience</h3>
                                        <p>Watermen’s Retreat provides a fresh look at the waterfront resort experience. Watermen’s consists of 14 waterfront suites, a secluded cottage plus a range of budget friendly cabanas.</p>
                                    </div>                                    
                                                                                                     <div class="item">
                                        <h3>Vacation time is a precious commodity</h3>
                                        <p>Our goal at Watermen’s Retreat is to always exceed expectations and make the most of your time to unwind. The Watermen’s atmosphere is family friendly and inclusive. Watermen’s Retreat is not only for kiteboarders and surfers, it’s for anyone who enjoys being a part of the excitement and fun.</p>
                                    </div>

<section class="faqDroper  FQ-1 ">
                <div class="questionList">    
        	        	                        <div class="questionCat">
                                                    <h3 class="catTitle">WATERMEN’S RETREAT FAQ</h3>
                                                <ul class="drops ">                          
                        	                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What time is check in/check out?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Check in is available any time after 5pm. Check out time is 10am.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Where do I pick up my keys?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>You can pick up your keys at the Watermen’s Retreat welcome desk located at REAL Watersports in Waves, NC.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What time does your office open and close for checking in and checking out?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>The Watermen’s Retreat welcome desk is staffed 9am to 6pm. If you arrive after hours, instructions are provided within an email you received at the time of booking. You will also receive a text with late check in procedures if you have not arrived by 6pm.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What is included in the rate?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Fully furnished rooms with made beds and bath towels, fully equipped kitchens, in room washer/dryer, secure gear storage, parking, cable tv, high-speed Wi-Fi internet, private kite launch access at REAL Watersports.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What payment methods do you accept?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Charges for all Watermen's Retreat properties will be processed by Flying R Inc. We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">When do you charge for the reservation?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Reservations will be charged in full at the time of booking.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Do you charge tax on the reservations?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>12.75% tax is applied to all reservations.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Do you include Travel Insurance on your bookings?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Travel Insurance may be obtained at the time of booking but will not be included in a reservation unless requested. Exclusions and limitations may apply.
<br />
<br />
Please check this site for insurances that are available through Watermen’s Retreat/Flying R.
<br />
<br />
Watermen’s Retreat/Flying R, through InsureStays via RentalGuardian is pleased to offer Travel Protection. Travel Protection is an important way to protect your vacation investment against unforeseen circumstances that may occur before or during your scheduled trip.
<br />
<br />
As per the North Carolina Vacation Rental Act, if the insurance is waived, neither the owner nor Watermen’s Retreat/Flying R is liable for refunds.
<br />
<br />
Contact us for more specific information regarding travel insurance.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What is your cancellation policy?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>If you cancel on or before 60 days prior to arrival, we will refund 100% of your money minus the cancellation fee.
<br />
<br />
If you cancel on or before 30 days prior to arrival, we will refund 50% of your money minus the cancellation fee.
<br />
<br />
If you cancel 29 or fewer days prior to arrival, there will be no refund.
<br />
<br />
Cancellation fee of $150 will be applied to refunded reservations.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Do you allow pets?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Dogs (max 2) are permitted in our cottage and cabanas with a non- refundable pet fee of $175 and a signed waiver. Pets are not permitted in any of our suites or penthouses.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	                        </ul>                
                    </div><!--End questionCat-->
        	            	        </div><!--End questionList-->
